description: This source file defines a frontend component named 'HomeScreen' using the LightningJS framework. It manages state, handles search input, fetches recipe data, and renders a grid of recipe cards, along with loading, error, and empty states.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing the home screen of the recipe explorer, with search capabilities and a grid display of recipes.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Handles search queries, triggers data loading based on the search input.

methods.name: renderCard
methods.description: Renders a recipe card component for a given recipe item.

methods.name: xPos
methods.description: Calculates the x-coordinate for a recipe card based on its index.

methods.name: yPos
methods.description: Calculates the y-coordinate for a recipe card based on its index.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Loads recipes from the data service, updates state accordingly, handles errors.
